constraint_help.region_west: The Census Bureau West region: the Mountain states plus the Pacific coast.
constraint_help.region_south: The Census Bureau South region, which runs from Delaware down to Texas.
constraint_help.region_midwest: The Census Bureau Midwest region: the Great Lakes states plus the Plains.
constraint_help.region_northeast: The Census Bureau Northeast region: New England plus the Mid-Atlantic.
constraint_help.sub_new_england: The six states in the far northeast corner of the country.
constraint_help.sub_mid_atlantic: The band of states between New England and the South, on the middle Atlantic coast.
constraint_help.sub_deep_south: The historic cotton states of the far south, around the Gulf and the lower Mississippi.
constraint_help.sub_plains: The open agricultural states west of the Mississippi and east of the Rockies.
constraint_help.sub_mountain: The interior western states built around the Rocky Mountain chain.
constraint_help.sub_pacific: The states with a Pacific Ocean shoreline.
constraint_help.coast_great_lakes: Touches at least one of the five Great Lakes. Inland water counts here, ocean does not.
constraint_help.landlocked: No ocean coastline and no Great Lakes shoreline.
constraint_help.political_red: Leans Republican: it has backed the Republican nominee in recent presidential elections.
constraint_help.political_blue: Leans Democratic: it has backed the Democratic nominee in recent presidential elections.
constraint_help.political_swing: A battleground: it has gone to both parties across recent presidential elections.
constraint_help.original_13: One of the thirteen British colonies that declared independence in 1776.
constraint_help.confederate: Seceded and joined the Confederacy during the Civil War.
constraint_help.on_mississippi: The Mississippi River runs along its border or straight through it.
constraint_help.mt_rockies: Part of the Rocky Mountain chain lies inside the state.
constraint_help.desert_state: Contains a major desert, such as the Mojave, Sonoran, Chihuahuan or Great Basin.
constraint_help.four_corners: One of the four states that meet at a single point in the Southwest.
constraint_help.great_plains: Sits on the flat grassland belt east of the Rockies.
constraint_help.bible_belt: Part of the southern region where evangelical Protestantism is culturally dominant.
constraint_help.rust_belt: Part of the old industrial heartland near the Great Lakes that lost its heavy manufacturing.
constraint_help.route_66: The original Route 66 crossed this state on its way from Chicago to Santa Monica.
constraint_help.has_million_city: At least one city inside the state has over a million residents.
constraint_help.largest_state: Ranked in the top 5 by land area. This is about size, not population.
constraint_help.smallest_state: Ranked in the bottom 5 by land area. This is about size, not population.
constraint_help.has_nba: Home to at least one NBA franchise.
constraint_help.sun_belt: The warm southern band running from the Southeast across to the Southwest.
constraint_help.snow_belt: The northern states that take heavy winter and lake-effect snowfall.
constraint_help.corn_belt: The Midwestern band where corn is the dominant crop.
constraint_help.wheat_belt: The Plains states where wheat is the dominant crop.
constraint_help.cotton_belt: The southern band where cotton was historically the dominant crop.
constraint_help.tornado_alley: Part of the central corridor with the highest tornado frequency in the country.
constraint_help.hurricane_zone: Exposed to Atlantic or Gulf hurricanes making landfall.
constraint_help.earthquake_zone: Sits on active fault lines, with a real earthquake risk.
constraint_help.has_volcano: Has at least one volcano classed as active.
constraint_help.multi_timezone: The state is split across two time zones.
constraint_help.statehood_pre_1800: Admitted to the Union before 1800. This is the date of statehood, not of settlement.
constraint_help.statehood_1900s: Admitted to the Union in the twentieth century, so one of the last to join.
constraint_help.name_native_origin: The state name comes from a Native American word.
constraint_help.name_spanish_origin: The state name comes from Spanish.
constraint_help.name_royalty_origin: The state was named after a king, a queen or a member of a royal house.
constraint_help.borders_6_plus: Shares a land border with six or more other states.
constraint_help.borders_few: Shares a land border with three other states or fewer.
constraint_help.capital_named_after_president: The state capital is named after a US president.
constraint_help.double_letter: The English name has the same letter twice in a row, as in Tennessee.
constraint_help.starts_and_ends_vowel: The English name opens and closes on a vowel, as in Alabama.
constraint_help.pc_pro_team_animal_name: A major pro sports team based here is named after an animal.
constraint_help.pc_big12_school: At least one university here plays in the Big 12 athletic conference.
constraint_help.pc_real_housewives_franchise: A city in this state has its own Real Housewives series.
constraint_help.pc_stephen_king_setting: At least one Stephen King novel takes place here.
constraint_help.pc_marvel_mcu_us_setting: A Marvel Cinematic Universe film shot scenes in this state.
constraint_help.pc_pixar_film_setting: A Pixar feature is set in this state.
constraint_help.pc_tarantino_setting: A Quentin Tarantino film is set in this state.
constraint_help.pc_top10_engineering_uni: Home to a university ranked in the national top 10 for engineering.
constraint_help.pc_top10_law_school: Home to a law school ranked in the national top 10.
constraint_help.pc_top10_med_school: Home to a medical school ranked in the national top 10.
constraint_help.pc_top_business_school: Home to a business school ranked in the national top 10.
constraint_help.pc_top_liberal_arts: Home to one of the country's top-ranked liberal arts colleges.
constraint_help.pc_ivy_league_home: One of the eight Ivy League universities sits in this state.
constraint_help.pc_nasa_facility: Hosts a major NASA centre, such as a launch site or a research campus.
constraint_help.pc_major_cruise_port: Has a port that major cruise lines sail from.
constraint_help.pc_iconic_cocktail: A well known cocktail is named after or closely tied to this state.
constraint_help.pc_disaster_movie_set: A disaster movie is set in this state.
constraint_help.pc_cop_show_setting: A well known police series is set in this state.
constraint_help.pc_medical_drama_set: A well known hospital series is set in this state.
constraint_help.pc_long_river_state: One of the longest rivers in the country runs through or along the state.
constraint_help.pc_underground_subway: A city here runs a subway or metro system.
constraint_help.pc_movie_spielberg: A Steven Spielberg film is set in this state.
constraint_help.pc_movie_scorsese: A Martin Scorsese film is set in this state.
constraint_help.pc_movie_anderson_wes: A Wes Anderson film is set in this state.
constraint_help.pc_movie_eastwood: A Clint Eastwood film is set in this state.
constraint_help.pc_movie_marvel_loc: A Marvel film shot scenes in this state.
constraint_help.pc_movie_pixar_inspo: A Pixar film drew its setting from this state.
constraint_help.pc_christopher_nolan_us: A Christopher Nolan film shot on location in this state.
constraint_help.pc_music_taylor_swift: The Eras Tour played at least one date in this state.
constraint_help.pc_music_beyonce_tour: The Renaissance World Tour played at least one date in this state.
constraint_help.pc_music_dylan_song: A Bob Dylan song names this state or is set there.
constraint_help.pc_born_president_post60: A US president who took office after 1960 was born here.
constraint_help.pc_born_first_lady: A US First Lady was born in this state.
constraint_help.pc_amusement_park_top: Home to one of the ten most visited amusement parks in the country.
constraint_help.pc_hist_spanish_colonial: Was under Spanish rule before it became part of the United States.
constraint_help.pc_hist_french_colonial: Was under French rule before it became part of the United States.
constraint_help.pc_red_state_consistent: Has voted Republican in every presidential election since 2000.
constraint_help.pc_blue_state_consistent: Has voted Democratic in every presidential election since 2000.
constraint_help.pc_largest_state_area: Ranked in the top 5 by land area. This is about size, not population.
constraint_help.pc_smallest_state_area: Ranked in the bottom 5 by land area. This is about size, not population.
constraint_help.pc_top_population_2: One of the five most populous states. This is about people, not size.
constraint_help.pc_lowest_population: One of the five least populous states. This is about people, not size.
constraint_help.pc_two_syllables: The English name is pronounced in two syllables, as in Texas or Kansas.
constraint_help.pc_sea_level_low: Its lowest point sits at or very near sea level.
constraint_help.pc_named_after_person: The state is named after a real person rather than a place or a word.
constraint_help.pc_named_after_river: The state takes its name from a river.
constraint_help.pc_named_native_tribe: The state is named after a Native American people.
constraint_help.pc_french_origin_name: The state name comes from French.
constraint_help.pc_capital_is_largest: The capital is also the most populous city in the state, which is the exception rather than the rule.
constraint_help.pc_volcano_active: Has at least one volcano classed as active.
constraint_help.pc_multiple_time_zones: The state is split across two time zones.
constraint_help.pc_super_bowl_host: A stadium in this state has hosted at least one Super Bowl.
constraint_help.pc_olympics_host_any: A city here has hosted the summer or winter Olympic Games.
constraint_help.pc_state_capital_small: The state capital has fewer than 100,000 residents.
